main_text.p:
Et mox deorsum tendere, mox rapi
Surfum Saganti forte, suas tamen
Rerum fugaci tradere inanium
Spes quaerit Umbra: quisque hominem asperis
Fidele fulcrum temporibus sibi
Credit futurum: follicitus licet
Hunc Vsque cernat cladibus impeti.
Nec esse quidquam quod ruat ocyus.
Non quotquot errant montibus auiis
Fera rapaces, nec pecudum agmina
Malus premuntur pluribus, aut mage
Incerta casus ambiguos pauent,
Quam mentis illum ludit amabilis
Error, periclis Viuere qui procul
Damnisque cunctis expetit. Hoc Deus
Coeli recusat prouidus arbiter.
Nos, donec almo munere Sefcimur
Telluris, altum tendere ad aetherem,
Arctoque Veram quaerere tramite
Vitam, labores per Sarios iubet,
Sic sic Abramus sperni t humum, & Saga
Vesana plebis dogmata respuens
Fidit parenti sydereo, & malis
Maior beatas quarit opes polo.
O, pergat illi Caelicolum Deus
Fauere semper, rebus & arduis
Fausum benignus prabeat exitum.

page.notes: Verse is printed as continuous lines; OCR-level transcription. Several words in the first lines are doubtful due to the long-s and worn type; "Sagant" and "Surfum" may be misprints. Some words near the right edge are faint and may be inaccurate. The ornamental marks in the lower margin are not text and are omitted.
